statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n = n.divisors.sum (fun d => -(ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℝ)*Real.log d)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 短长除数与奇偶 · TP-0027 · 验证 Mangoldt 的带符号除数公式
plain_statement.en: New route · Short and long divisors · TP-0027 · Recover Mangoldt from the signed divisor sum

brief.zh: 对 log n 的除数分解作 Möbius 反演，检查 n=1。
brief.en: Apply Möbius inversion to the divisor decomposition of log n, including n=1.
